q.en: Why do I never look like the people in reels and ads?
q.hg: Main kabhi reels aur ads wale logon jaisa kyun nahi dikhta/dikhti?

a.en: Because they do not look like that either. Before a reel or ad reaches you, there has been make-up, special lighting, a flattering camera angle, many retakes and usually a filter or editing app that smooths skin and reshapes faces and bodies. You are comparing your normal, unedited self with a finished product made by a team. Real skin has pores, marks and hair, and real bodies come in many shapes. If comparing is making you sad or stopping you from eating properly, talk to a parent, teacher or counsellor.
a.hg: Kyunki woh khud bhi real mein waise nahi dikhte. Koi reel ya ad tum tak pahunchne se pehle usmein makeup, special lighting, flattering camera angle, kaafi retakes aur aksar koi filter ya editing app lag chuka hota hai jo skin smooth karta hai aur face aur body ka shape badal deta hai. Tum apne normal, unedited self ko ek poori team ke banaye finished product se compare kar rahe ho. Real skin mein pores, marks aur baal hote hain, aur real bodies kai shapes ki hoti hain. Agar comparison se tum sad rehne lago ya theek se khaana chhod do, toh mummy-papa, teacher ya counsellor se baat karo.

q.en: A weird adult video popped up while I was playing a game. Am I in trouble?
q.hg: Game khelte time achanak ek ajeeb adult video aa gaya. Kya main trouble mein hoon?

a.en: No. Things made only for adults can appear by accident through ads, links or forwarded messages, and that is not your fault. Close it, and do not click the link again or share it. Then tell a parent or another trusted adult what happened, so they can block it and answer any questions you have. What you saw is acted and edited; it is not how real people or relationships are. It is normal to feel confused, curious or a bit upset afterwards. Talking about it helps more than keeping it inside.
a.hg: Nahi. Sirf adults ke liye bani cheezein ads, links ya forwarded messages se galti se saamne aa sakti hain, aur yeh tumhari galti nahi hai. Use band karo, aur us link pe dobara click mat karo ya share mat karo. Phir mummy-papa ya kisi aur trusted adult ko batao kya hua, taaki woh use block kar sakein aur tumhare sawaalon ke jawab de sakein. Tumne jo dekha usmein acting aur editing hoti hai; real log ya relationships aise nahi hote. Uske baad confused, curious ya thoda upset feel karna normal hai. Andar dabake rakhne se zyada help baat karne se milti hai.

q.en: Someone I met in a game sent me a rude picture and told me not to tell anyone. What should I do?
q.hg: Game mein mile kisi insaan ne mujhe ek gandi photo bheji aur bola kisi ko mat batana. Mujhe kya karna chahiye?

a.en: Tell a trusted adult right now, even though they said to keep it secret. A person who sends sexual or rude pictures to a child and asks for secrecy is doing something wrong and illegal; you have done nothing wrong. Do not reply, do not send any photo of yourself, and do not delete the chat, because adults may need it to report the account. Block the person after an adult has seen it. You or the adult can call Child Helpline 1098 or report at cybercrime.gov.in. Telling is the right thing to do, and it is never your fault.
a.hg: Abhi kisi trusted adult ko batao, chahe usne secret rakhne ko bola ho. Jo insaan kisi bachche ko sexual ya gandi photos bhejta hai aur chup rehne ko bolta hai, woh galat aur illegal kaam kar raha hai; tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Reply mat karo, apni koi photo mat bhejo, aur chat delete mat karo, kyunki account report karne ke liye badon ko uski zaroorat pad sakti hai. Jab koi adult use dekh le, uske baad us insaan ko block kar do. Tum ya woh adult Child Helpline 1098 pe call kar sakte ho ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report kar sakte ho. Batana hi sahi step hai, aur isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai.

q.en: I got curious and watched porn. Does that make me a bad person?
q.hg: Curiosity mein maine porn dekh liya. Kya isse main bura insaan ban gaya/gayi?

a.en: No. Curiosity about sex is a normal part of being a teenager, and many people your age come across porn, by accident or on purpose. It does not make you dirty, sinful or 'spoilt'. What matters is knowing what you watched: scripted, edited adult entertainment that gets bodies, consent and relationships wrong. It is made for adults, so it is not a good source for your questions. If it left you guilty, worried about your body or unable to stop thinking about it, talk to a trusted adult, counsellor or doctor. You can also ask your questions here.
a.hg: Nahi. Sex ko leke curiosity teenager hone ka normal hissa hai, aur tumhari age ke bahut logon ke saamne porn aa jaata hai — galti se ya jaan-boojh ke. Isse tum gande, paapi ya 'bigde hue' nahi ho jaate. Zaroori yeh samajhna hai ki tumne jo dekha woh kya tha: adults ke liye bana scripted, edited entertainment, jo bodies, consent aur relationships ko galat dikhata hai. Yeh adults ke liye bana hai, isliye tumhare sawaalon ke liye achha source nahi hai. Agar iske baad guilt ho, apni body ki tension ho ya yeh dimaag se na nikle, toh kisi trusted adult, counsellor ya doctor se baat karo. Tum apne sawaal yahan bhi puch sakte ho.

q.en: Is real sex like what is shown in porn?
q.hg: Kya real sex waisa hi hota hai jaisa porn mein dikhate hain?

a.en: No. Porn is a performance: selected performers, a script, hours of filming cut down to minutes, chosen camera angles and acted reactions. It usually skips everything that matters in real life, such as asking for and giving consent, talking, nervousness, protection from pregnancy and infections, and care for the other person. It also shows a narrow set of body types and treats aggression as normal. Real intimacy between adults depends on trust, communication and respect, and it looks different for different people. Using porn as a guide is like using a car-chase scene as a driving manual.
a.hg: Nahi. Porn ek performance hai: chune hue performers, script, ghanton ki shooting jise kaat ke kuch minutes ka banaya jaata hai, chune hue camera angles aur acted reactions. Yeh aksar woh sab skip kar deta hai jo real life mein matter karta hai, jaise consent maangna aur dena, baat karna, nervousness, pregnancy aur infections se protection, aur saamne wale ki care. Yeh gine-chune body types dikhata hai aur aggression ko normal batata hai. Adults ke beech real intimacy trust, communication aur respect pe tiki hoti hai, aur alag-alag logon ke liye alag dikhti hai. Porn ko guide maanna waisa hai jaise car chase scene ko driving manual maan lena.

q.en: My friends tease me because I don't watch porn. What do I say?
q.hg: Mere dost mujhe chidhate hain kyunki main porn nahi dekhta/dekhti. Main kya bolun?

a.en: You do not owe anyone an explanation. A short, calm line works best: 'Not my thing', 'I'm good' or 'Send me the match highlights instead'. Teasing usually fades when it gets no reaction. Not watching is completely normal, and a lot of what friends claim to know is exaggeration or copied from scripted videos. If the group keeps sending you clips you did not ask for, mute it or leave; sending sexual content to someone who does not want it is harassment. If the pressure gets heavy, talk to a trusted adult or counsellor.
a.hg: Tumhe kisi ko explanation dene ki zaroorat nahi hai. Chhoti, calm line best kaam karti hai: 'Not my thing', 'Main theek hoon' ya 'Iski jagah match highlights bhej de'. Jab koi reaction nahi milta toh chidhana aksar apne aap kam ho jaata hai. Na dekhna poori tarah normal hai, aur dost jo kuch 'jaanne' ka claim karte hain usmein kaafi kuch exaggeration ya scripted videos se uthaya hua hota hai. Agar group bina maange clips bhejta rahe, toh mute karo ya leave karo; jo nahi chahta use sexual content bhejna harassment hai. Agar pressure bahut badh jaaye, toh kisi trusted adult ya counsellor se baat karo.

q.en: I keep watching porn even when I don't want to. Am I addicted?
q.hg: Main na chahte hue bhi baar-baar porn dekhta/dekhti hoon. Kya mujhe addiction ho gayi hai?

a.en: An app cannot diagnose that, but your concern deserves attention. Experts disagree on the word 'addiction'; what they agree on is that some people develop compulsive use that feels out of control. Warning signs are repeated failed attempts to cut down, using it mainly to escape stress or loneliness, losing sleep, study or work time, needing more extreme content, and feeling distressed afterwards. Start with small changes: phone outside the bedroom at night, noticing your triggers, planning something else for that time. If it continues, a counsellor, psychologist or doctor can help without judgement, and Tele-MANAS is free on 14416.
a.hg: Koi app iska diagnosis nahi kar sakta, lekin tumhari concern pe dhyan dena zaroori hai. 'Addiction' word pe experts ek-mat nahi hain; jis baat pe woh agree karte hain woh yeh hai ki kuch logon mein aisa use ban jaata hai jo out of control lagta hai. Warning signs hain: kam karne ki baar-baar fail koshishein, ise mainly stress ya akelepan se bhaagne ke liye use karna, neend, padhai ya kaam ka time khona, aur zyada extreme content ki zaroorat padna, aur baad mein distressed feel karna. Chhote changes se shuru karo: raat ko phone bedroom se bahar, apne triggers notice karna, us time ke liye kuch aur plan karna. Agar yeh chalta rahe, toh counsellor, psychologist ya doctor bina judge kiye help kar sakte hain, aur Tele-MANAS 14416 pe free hai.

q.en: Can watching porn affect my erections or my sex life with a partner?
q.hg: Kya porn dekhne se mere erections ya partner ke saath meri sex life pe asar pad sakta hai?

a.en: It can for some people, but research is mixed and it is not a simple cause and effect. Some adults report that heavy use goes along with difficulty getting aroused with a partner, unrealistic expectations or less satisfaction; others report no effect. Performance anxiety from comparing yourself with performers is a common link. Erection difficulties also have many physical causes, including diabetes, high blood pressure, smoking, alcohol and some medicines. If the problem keeps happening, see a doctor rather than guessing, and avoid pills or 'boosters' sold online. Talking honestly with your partner reduces the pressure.
a.hg: Kuch logon mein pad sakta hai, lekin research mixed hai aur yeh seedha cause-and-effect wala maamla nahi hai. Kuch adults batate hain ki heavy use ke saath partner ke saath arouse hone mein difficulty, unrealistic expectations ya kam satisfaction aayi; dusron ko koi asar feel nahi hota. Khud ko performers se compare karne se aayi performance anxiety ek common link hai. Erection ki difficulty ke kaafi physical causes bhi hote hain, jaise diabetes, high blood pressure, smoking, alcohol aur kuch medicines. Agar problem baar-baar ho, toh guess karne ke bajaye doctor ko dikhayein, aur online bikne wali pills ya 'boosters' se bachein. Partner se honestly baat karne se pressure kam hota hai.

q.en: Someone made a fake nude of me using AI. What do I do?
q.hg: Kisi ne AI se meri fake nude bana di hai. Main kya karun?

a.en: This is abuse, and you are not to blame, whether the original photo was public or private. Do not confront or pay the person who made it. Note the account name, link and date, keep the chat undeleted, and do not forward the image to anyone. Tell a trusted adult today. Report it at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 and use the platform's report option; if you are under 18 you can also call 1098. A sexual image of a person under 18, even an AI-made one, is treated as child sexual abuse material. If you feel overwhelmed, call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
a.hg: Yeh abuse hai, aur isme tumhara koi blame nahi, chahe original photo public rahi ho ya private. Jisne yeh banayi hai usse bhido mat aur use paise mat do. Account ka naam, link aur date note kar lo, chat delete mat karo, aur woh image kisi ko forward mat karo. Aaj hi kisi trusted adult ko batao. cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 pe report karo aur platform ka report option use karo; agar tum 18 se kam ho toh 1098 pe bhi call kar sakte ho. 18 se kam umar ke insaan ki sexual image, chahe AI se bani ho, child sexual abuse material maani jaati hai. Agar sab bahut heavy lage, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo.

q.en: A stranger is threatening to send my private photo to my family unless I pay. I'm terrified.
q.hg: Ek stranger dhamki de raha hai ki paise nahi diye toh meri private photo meri family ko bhej dega. Mujhe bahut dar lag raha hai.

a.en: You are being targeted by a crime called sextortion, and you can get through this. Do not pay: payment almost always brings bigger demands. Do not send more photos. Stop replying, but do not delete the chat, the profile details or payment IDs. Tell a trusted adult now; the fear of telling is exactly what blackmailers rely on. Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930, or go to the police; if you are under 18, 1098 can guide you. Report the account on the platform too. If you feel hopeless or think of hurting yourself, call 112 or Tele-MANAS 14416 immediately.
a.hg: Tum sextortion naam ke crime ka target bane ho, aur tum isse nikal sakte ho. Paise mat do: paise dene ke baad lagbhag hamesha demands aur badi ho jaati hain. Aur photos mat bhejo. Reply karna band karo, lekin chat, profile details ya payment IDs delete mat karo. Abhi kisi trusted adult ko batao; blackmailers theek isi dar pe tike hote hain ki tum kisi ko bataoge nahi. cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo ya 1930 pe call karo, ya police ke paas jao; agar tum 18 se kam ho toh 1098 tumhe guide kar sakta hai. Platform pe bhi us account ko report karo. Agar koi umeed na dikhe ya khud ko hurt karne ka khayal aaye, toh turant 112 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo.

q.en: Everyone in my group already has the leaked video. Is it still wrong if I forward it?
q.hg: Mere group mein sabke paas woh leaked video pehle se hai. Kya tab bhi use forward karna galat hai?

a.en: Yes. Every forward is a fresh violation of the person in it and can be an offence in India under the IT Act, which covers sharing sexually explicit material and private images without consent. 'It was already viral' does not protect you. If the person shown is under 18, even keeping it is an offence, because it is child sexual abuse material. Do not forward or save it, tell the group to stop, and report it at cybercrime.gov.in, on 1930 or to the police, and also on the platform. If you are under 18, tell a trusted adult or call 1098. Laws can change; this is not legal advice.
a.hg: Haan. Har forward us insaan ke saath ek nayi violation hai aur India mein IT Act ke under offence ho sakta hai, jisme sexually explicit material aur bina consent private images share karna cover hota hai. 'Woh toh pehle se viral tha' bolne se tum nahi bach jaate. Agar usme dikh raha insaan 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh use rakhna bhi offence hai, kyunki woh child sexual abuse material hai. Use forward ya save mat karo, group ko bolo yeh band karein, aur cybercrime.gov.in pe, 1930 pe ya police mein report karo, aur platform pe bhi. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 pe call karo. Laws badal sakte hain; yeh legal advice nahi hai.

q.en: I feel like my favourite streamer actually knows me. Is that weird?
q.hg: Mujhe lagta hai mera favourite streamer mujhe sach mein jaanta hai. Kya yeh weird hai?

a.en: It is common, and it has a name: a parasocial relationship. Creators talk to the camera as if to a friend, share daily life and reply to comments, so your brain files them under 'people I know'. The bond is one-sided: they know an audience, not you. It becomes a problem when it replaces real friendships, when you spend money you cannot afford on gifts or subscriptions to get noticed, or when you accept their health, body or dating advice without checking. Enjoy the content, keep your wallet and your judgement, and invest in people who can know you back.
a.hg: Yeh common hai, aur iska ek naam hai: parasocial relationship. Creators camera se aise baat karte hain jaise kisi dost se kar rahe hon, apni daily life dikhate hain aur comments ka reply karte hain, isliye tumhara brain unhe 'jaan-pehchaan walon' mein gin leta hai. Yeh bond one-sided hai: woh apni audience ko jaante hain, tumhe nahi. Yeh tab problem banta hai jab yeh real friendships ki jagah le le, jab tum notice hone ke liye gifts ya subscriptions pe woh paise kharch karo jo tumhare paas hain hi nahi, ya jab tum health, body ya dating pe unki advice bina check kiye maan lo. Content enjoy karo, apna wallet aur apni judgement sambhal ke rakho, aur un logon mein invest karo jo tumhe bhi jaan sakein.

q.en: Is it illegal to pay for sex in India?
q.hg: Kya India mein paise dekar sex karna illegal hai?

a.en: The law is not simple; treat this as a rough map. Under the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, an adult privately selling sex is not itself an offence, but soliciting in public, running a brothel, pimping and trafficking are, and prostitution near places such as schools, hospitals and places of worship is punishable. Courts have differed on when a customer can be prosecuted. Two things are clear: sex with anyone under 18 is a serious crime under POCSO, paid or not, and sexually exploiting a trafficked person is a crime. A buyer usually cannot know whether someone is trafficked or under age. No lawyer has reviewed this; laws change.
a.hg: Law simple nahi hai, isliye ise ek rough map samjho. Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act ke under kisi adult ka privately sex bechna apne aap mein offence nahi hai, par public mein soliciting, brothel chalana, pimping aur trafficking offences hain, aur school, hospital aur pooja ki jagahon jaise public places ke paas prostitution bhi punishable hai. Customer par case kab chal sakta hai, is par courts ki rai alag-alag rahi hai. Do baatein clear hain: 18 se kam umar ke insaan ke saath sex POCSO ke under serious crime hai, paise diye hon ya nahi, aur trafficked insaan ka sexual exploitation karna crime hai. Buyer usually yeh nahi jaan sakta ki saamne wala trafficked hai ya under age. Ise kisi lawyer ne review nahi kiya hai; laws badalte rehte hain.

q.en: How can I tell whether a porn video was made with real consent?
q.hg: Main kaise jaanun ki koi porn video real consent se bana tha ya nahi?

a.en: You usually cannot. Nothing on screen, including smiles, a studio logo or a 'verified' tag, proves that every person agreed to the acts, to filming and to publication, or that they are adults. To lower the chance of watching abuse, avoid anything labelled leaked, hidden camera, MMS, drunk or sleeping, and anything passed around in chat groups. If someone seems unaware or frightened, close it and report it. If anyone may be under 18, stop at once: viewing, keeping or sharing sexual material of a child is a serious crime; report it at cybercrime.gov.in. Not watching is also a valid choice, and watching does not make you a bad person.
a.hg: Usually tum nahi jaan sakte. Screen pe dikhne wali koi bhi cheez, chahe smile ho, studio logo ho ya 'verified' tag, yeh prove nahi karti ki har insaan un acts, film hone aur publish hone par agree tha, ya ki woh adults hain. Abuse dekhne ka chance kam karne ke liye aisi kisi bhi cheez se bacho jis par leaked, hidden camera, MMS, drunk ya sleeping jaisa label ho, aur jo chat groups mein ghoom rahi ho. Agar koi unaware ya dara hua lage, toh use band karo aur report karo. Agar koi 18 se kam umar ka ho sakta hai, toh turant ruko: kisi bachche ka sexual material dekhna, rakhna ya share karna serious crime hai; cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo. Bilkul na dekhna bhi valid choice hai, aur dekhne se tum bure insaan nahi ban jaate.

q.en: I came across a video that looks like rape, or shows someone who looks under 18. What should I do?
q.hg: Mujhe ek aisa video dikha jo rape jaisa lagta hai, ya jisme koi 18 se kam umar ka lagta hai. Mujhe kya karna chahiye?

a.en: Do not download, save, screenshot or forward it, not even to a friend or as 'proof'; where a child is shown, keeping or sharing it is itself a crime. Stop watching. Note where you saw it: the site address, or the group, username or number that sent it, and leave the chat undeleted. Report it with the platform's report button and at cybercrime.gov.in, which has a section for child sexual abuse and rape content and accepts anonymous reports, or call 1930. If you know of a child in danger, call 1098 or 112. Seeing such material can be disturbing; Tele-MANAS (14416) is free. This is general information, not legal advice.
a.hg: Use download, save, screenshot ya forward mat karo, kisi friend ko bhi nahi aur 'proof' ke taur par bhi nahi; jahan koi bachcha dikh raha ho, wahan use rakhna ya share karna apne aap mein crime hai. Dekhna band karo. Note karo ki woh kahan dikha: site ka address, ya woh group, username ya number jisne bheja, aur chat ko delete mat karo. Platform ke report button se aur cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo, jahan child sexual abuse aur rape content ke liye alag section hai aur anonymous report bhi li jaati hai, ya 1930 pe call karo. Agar tum kisi aise bachche ko jaante ho jo khatre mein hai, toh 1098 ya 112 pe call karo. Aisa material dekhna disturbing ho sakta hai; Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.
